chose: Hold a Stop for failed covering runs once per (lines, newest edit time) per session, in both modes; a strict ask with no covering run still holds every time
over: Holding on every Stop until a pass (D65's failure rule), or letting related-test passes outvote a failed suite run (rejected in felt-latency D5)
because: Runs record only cmd, ok and exit, so a load flake can't be told from a real failure. A re-run with no edit can't fix a real failure, so a second hold only forces another full suite run (shim-latency fails at load and never records a pass).
